reviews.text: Very pleasant staff and knowledgeable vets! I just moved and they were able to see me on very short notice and provided everything I needed. I would highly recommend!

I also bring my own cat here for vaccines and checkups, and the care is always exceptional—even when she’s feeling feisty! The staff truly care about their patients and their owners. Highly recommend this veterinary office!👍🏼👍🏼

I want to express my endless gratitude to Dr. Alexandra Valencia and the entire team at Pet House Clinic for the exceptionally special care they gave Jerry, my beloved four-legged child.
Jerry is incredibly important to me. He was diagnosed with a liver tumor and gallbladder problems. Dr. Amalia López and Dr. Lilly Uribazo also collaborated in his diagnosis, and he was operated on by Dr. Mario Cabrera at Dr. Valencia’s clinic.
From the very first moment, Dr. Valencia and her team showed impeccable dedication. Immediately after surgery, Jerry was closely monitored and cared for constantly, making sure he wasn’t in pain and that his recovery was smooth and complication-free.
Dr. Valencia’s kindness, professionalism, expertise, and empathy, along with her team’s, were crucial for me during such a difficult time. I am completely sure that Jerry could not have been in better hands.
Eternal thanks to Dr. Valencia and Pet House Clinic. I recommend this clinic without hesitation!!!

What meant the most to us was that even while she was on vacation, she continued to check in and make sure Luke was receiving the care he needed. Her dedication, expertise, and genuine compassion gave us so much peace of mind during a stressful time.

Thanks to Dr. Valencia, Luke is doing great now. We are incredibly grateful and highly recommend her to anyone looking for a veterinarian who truly cares about her patients and their families.

They took the time to explain everything clearly, kept me updated, and handled her surgery with so much attention and professionalism. What really stands out to me is how well Lexi recovers every time, she’s happy, comfortable, and back to herself so quickly, which says everything about the level of care she’s receiving.

It’s not easy trusting someone with your pet, especially during surgery, but with Pet House Animal Clinic I feel completely at ease. They treat Lexi like she’s their own, and that means the world to me. Also they are so fast when you call them or email! they do a good job at remembering you and your pet, its saved me when i've been traveling with Lexi and needed some last minute documents.

Highly, highly recommend them to anyone looking for a vet that truly goes above and beyond

I can’t thank The Pet House enough for what they’ve done for me and my dog. For months we had been dealing with an infection in my dog’s glands, and Dr. Sarabia helped us every step of the way. He walked us through which antibiotics would be the most effective, what side effects to expect, and he was sure to answer all of our questions no matter how silly I thought they were.

When the infection cleared but my dog unfortunately needed surgery, he walked me through what to expect pre and post procedure. On that day, they called us several times to keep us informed with how he was managing the anesthesia and recovering. A few days later they even dropped everything to double check his post-op stitches when I thought he had torn them by jumping on the couch!

Dr. Sarabia was so caring and respectful of me and my dog during the process, and you can tell that the staff here really cares about the patients and the owners. There’s a level of thoughtfulness you feel here from the doctors to the techs to the front desk that really make you feel like you and your pet are in good hands.

I visited this clinic twice, and both experiences were extremely disappointing.
The first time was for an eye emergency with my dog. The visit lasted no more than 5 minutes, felt rushed, and lacked proper attention to what was clearly not a minor issue. Despite this, I was charged an excessive amount and prescribed medications that did not resolve the problem. The medications were also sold at what appeared to be significantly inflated prices compared to standard market rates.
The second visit was even worse. I reached out for travel documentation for my dogs and received an estimate close to $2,000. The quote included multiple procedures and tests that are not actually required for travel, presented in a way that could easily mislead pet owners into thinking they are mandatory.
At this point, it raises a serious question: is this due to lack of knowledge or intentional overcharging?
The clinic itself is outdated and poorly maintained, which makes the pricing even harder to justify. Yet outside, there is a brand new Mercedes G-Wagon which says a lot about where the money is going.
I will not be returning and would strongly recommend other pet owners to carefully verify any recommendations before proceeding here.

My dog was unexpectedly attacked by another dog, and he had two severe bite wounds on his shoulder and  his chest   I immediately called Pet House Clinic and even though they were about to close for the day, I was told to bring him right in. Upon arrival, Dr. Valencia  so Teddy and  assessed his wounds.  She was able to clearly explain the nature of the bites, what the different outcomes might  be, and how to care for him at home   His injury required the office to stay open much later than usual. Dr. Valencia was so caring and concerned that she called me that evening to check on my dog’s progress     I brought Teddy back to Dr Valencia three days in a row for her to check and clean out the wounds   Fortunately, Teddy’s wounds  did not become infected and  he healed perfectly. I am so thankful to Dr  Valencia for her knowledge, care and compassion.    I also want to mention that her staff is outstanding and the office is spotless.   I hope your pet never experiences an emergency but if they do, I could not recommend Pet House more highly.  Teddy will now go there for all his vet needs.
